observations: Photo 0 shows a blue laptop motherboard laid flat on a white surface. There are multiple chips, connectors, and a white sticker with a barcode and text near the center. The board has a distinct shape with cutouts and several orange standoffs.

Photo 1 shows the same motherboard from a different angle, placed on a dark textured surface. The cooling system with two fans and heat pipes is visible. There are also several white stickers with barcodes and QR codes, one near the top and one near the center.
The motherboard has a large black square chip (likely the CPU) near the bottom right in photo 1, and a smaller chip near the top left in photo 0.
The text 'DELIGHTSOME INSIGHT' is watermarked across both photos.
No visible branding or model numbers are readable on the board itself in either photo. The seller claims it is for an HP EliteBook x360 1030 G3, but this cannot be confirmed from the images.
